DeviceDescription/Description/DDTextFiel: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. The IS-200 is a single-use, sterile administration set consisting of a spike, a drip chamber, PVC tubing, a roller clamp, a needle-free Y-site and a male luer lock connector.
IndicationsForUse/Indications/IUTextFiel: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. The IS-200 infusion set is intended for the administration of intravenous fluids from a container to the vascular system of a patient by gravity or with an infusion pump.
